bayts.text: My worship (goes) to Him Who has effaced temptations and led to me, through the Chosen One, the texts (of knowledge).
Our Messenger Aḥmad, through his Lord, has given rest to my whole being, and it has found rest.
There has yielded to me that through which wisdoms yielded to me, through the Chosen One, whom the Judge (Al-Ḥakam) has exalted.
Glory be to Him Who has preferred the best of envoys, our Aḥmad, above all the messengers.
God refused that the master of creatures be like the creatures; and (he) has guided and illumined.
The peace of the Lord of the Throne and the blessing upon him through whom the spiteful have softened.
My pens, my ink and (my) body have triumphed, in my service to him who spared me from whoever envied (me).
Allah has made easy for me, through the service of the Established One (with God, the Prophet), every hard thing, which “Be, and it is” (Qurʾān 36:82) has tamed.
The Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) has come to meet me with glad tidings, in the service of the Chosen One, possessor of the sign.
The blessing of the Lord of the mighty Throne and peace upon the chosen Prophet, who effaces blame.
I have adorned, for my Lord, with al-Māḥī (Muḥammad), years of a worship whose reward has effaced all moaning.
My Lord has forgiven me what came before and what came after (Qurʾān 48:2), through an Effacer (al-Māḥī) who was set foremost.
My Lord has turned to me with a forgiveness that washed my faults through the Prophet, and they were washed away.
I have thanked Him for the Prophet, recounting (the favour, Qurʾān 93:11), ever since He led to me what He led to me: so recount!
The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has increased for me, by the rank of the one who ascends (Muḥammad), what led me to gratitude through (written) leaves.
The graces have called me to gratitude, through praise of the thankful servant of the Lord of creatures.
The beauty of my praise never ceases to be gladness, in secret and openly, for the Prophet of glad tidings.
Toward the Prophet I have turned what closed the gate of Gehenna, and it was closed away from us.
I have led to the Chosen One what led to opening the gate of the Gardens, and it opened toward us.
I have gladdened the Best of creation with the Qurʾān, and it is right guidance and the watering-place of the thirsty.
Our Lord, by the rank of the Chosen One, has set a barrier between me and all that is not chosen.
Praise of the Elect (al-Mujtabā) has transmuted substances for me, and leads to me with good pleasure what is chosen.
God, through the Prophet, has driven harm toward others than me, leading goodness to me.
My life has become good through the chosen Prophet, and what the God-fearing have loved has yielded to me.
I have intended to thank my King for the Prophet, a mercy for every near one and (every) stranger.
God has led to me that through which my being His servant, the Khadīm, has appeared and become renowned.
I am well pleased with Him Who has granted me my being His servant, attendant of the best of existence.
The Qurʾān has come to meet me with sweetness, and the Best of creatures has led to me its recitation.
The Ḥadīth of the Best of creation is companionship for me, after the Book of Him Who is the (true) Companion.
The Bestower (Al-Wahhāb) has granted me intimate converse, and He — exalted be He — is the best one with whom to converse intimately.
